caption: The drawing depicts the bust of a man with pale skin and dark hair that is combed back, wearing a dark blue coat with wide lapels and a high, white, ruffled collar. Underneath the coat, there is a yellow vest visible above the chest area. The bust is adorned at the bottom with a decorative, golden element featuring carved scroll-like designs and a leafy pattern. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or elements present. The composition centers the bust, with the figure's head slightly turned to the left. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner with the text: "FRANCIS W. ROWELL Federal Art Project."
title: Daniel Webster Figurehead
